instructions: Refine the failed source-measured component-authored Blender PBR assembly by converting its RoomScale Y-up component coordinates into Blender Z-up before GLB export. Rotate the assembly 90 degrees around X so Godot receives a horizontal 66 x 30 x 30 inch standing desk with the floor datum at Y=0. Preserve the measured glass top, dual telescoping lift columns, T-feet, independent hardware/materials, UV maps, and RoomScale integration. Compare actual production renders to desk-v007 and the source photograph. Reject on any incorrect orientation, primitive/blocky/low-poly appearance, weak close construction, implausible joints/material response, or insufficient photo-character.
